questionText: Q1. A dishonest merchant marks his goods 21% above cost price and uses a faulty weight that measures 851 grams for a kilogram. What is his net profit percentage?
explanation: Effective multiplier = (Marked Factor) / (Weight Factor) = (1 + markup%) * (1000 / actual_grams) => Net profit = 42.2%.
sourceReference: CAT Paper 2 — Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension

sourceReference: CAT Paper 2 — Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension
